headline: Marban Hollow Quickens as Nevish Line Falls Silent
war_summary: Since the midnight wire Marban Hollow has quickened to five transfers in two hours and thirty-five on the day about Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall for four Warden, three Colonial and one destroyed holding, last at 0149, while the Nevish Line has gone quiet with none in two hours after twenty-three in six and thirty-eight on the day about Blackcoat Way and Blinding Stones for five Warden, two Colonial and one destroyed, last at 0051. The Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest field with three in two hours and fifty-three on the day about Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Necropolis for three Warden, three Colonial and three destroyed, last at the 0301 wire, and Linn Mercy shows two in two hours and twenty-three on the day about Lathair and Outwich Ranch for eight Colonial, two Warden and one destroyed, last at 0138. Mooring County records two in two hours and fifteen on the day about the Wind Hills for eleven Warden and one destroyed, also last at the wire, and Stlican Shelf adds two in two hours and seven on the day about Briar, last at the wire. Callahan's Passage reports 8,549 Colonial and 6,286 Warden casualties on the day with no recorded transfer.
